authority: User execution request authorizes implementation phases 0–5; historical SC identifiers and counts are not gates.
version_decision: 2.2.0-dev.1 for protocol/evaluator/product; new binding/task required; old histories read-only, no converter or authorization bridge.

source_classes.engineering: Only minimum necessary consequences recorded per entry
source_classes.suggestions: No suggestions promoted into requirements or blockers

entries.necessity: Replace production Python with one TS implementation consumed by CLI and Cordis; retain runtime validation.
entries.oracle: Same core exports serve CLI and provider service; delivered package has no Python executable, bridge or fallback.
entries.minimum_verification: Build/typecheck; inspect finite bundle; actual installed commands and DSH execution.

entries.necessity: Preserve normative bytes and digests while explicitly versioning new implementation identity.
entries.oracle: Unicode key-order/domain/safe-integer vectors agree; malformed JSON and duplicate keys rejected; evaluator identity changes.
entries.minimum_verification: Python frozen baseline → TS differential vectors and Schema/CLI error tests.

entries.necessity: Prevent migration from weakening finite user scope or fixed Profile denominators.
entries.oracle: Explicit branches and Oracles remain required; scope revisions cannot change denominators; changed Profile needs init/new task.
entries.minimum_verification: Source-backed scope counterexamples and existing applicable assertions ported to TS.

entries.source: baseline acceptance_scope MethodSpec, scope Schema; user §6
entries.necessity: Keep suggestions isolated and legitimate auxiliary/diagnostic work available.
entries.oracle: Suggestions never add executable coverage/blockers; declared bounded auxiliary operations run when relevant review gaps remain.
entries.minimum_verification: Core and real runtime positive/negative scope/diagnostic scenarios.

entries.necessity: Keep source propositions, observed Oracles, necessity and semantic review separate from structure.
entries.oracle: Placeholders/missing Oracles/unresolved gaps fail affected claims without manufacturing business truth from hashes.
entries.minimum_verification: Port meaningful existing semantic assertions with exact verdict/reason checks.

entries.necessity: Do not transfer authorization between changed snapshots, claims, versions or worlds.
entries.minimum_verification: Stale input, claim omission, source change, old binding and execution ticket tests.

entries.necessity: Preserve durable atomic storage, immutable history and concurrency boundaries.
entries.oracle: Expected-digest CAS rejects conflicting writes; symlinks/escape fail; successful return implies durable matching records.
entries.minimum_verification: Real concurrent writers, interruption, immutable conflict and filesystem boundary tests.

entries.source: baseline evidence.py and execution Schema; user §6,9
entries.necessity: Preserve actual process/report truth and bounded lifecycle.
entries.oracle: Failure/zero/skip/xfail/missing report/timeout/cancellation remain distinguishable; model JSON cannot become managed execution.
entries.minimum_verification: Neutral real Node commands plus JUnit reports; cancellation/output limits and publication tests.

entries.necessity: Never treat opaque keys as local paths or assume one namespace.
entries.oracle: Configured providers used; unsupported/mismatched mapping rejects explicitly; synchronous guards consume only prepared state.
entries.minimum_verification: Real DSH provider seams, opaque/nonlocal/cross-world counterexamples, disposal/drain.

entries.source: user §5; updated TYPESCRIPT_CORDIS Team decision (new behavior)
entries.necessity: Use official Agent Team rather than substitute scheduling or direct-subagent claims.
entries.oracle: Real official roster/member creation/task CAS/messages/lifecycle drive bounded review; no BUGate Team state machine.
entries.minimum_verification: Pinned actual package/type inspection and deterministic model driving installed official Team runtime.

entries.necessity: Authenticate observable authorship and review execution through host observations, separate from semantic correctness.
entries.oracle: Renamed self-review, lead-written review, model identity fields, absent authorship and unsupported blind-review claims fail independence.
entries.minimum_verification: Actual author/member tool seams, fresh/fork policy positives/negatives; ordinary CLI JSON cannot create host receipts.

entries.necessity: Keep receipt/input/output references non-circular and precisely applicable after resume.
entries.oracle: Artifact/source/scope/plan/input changes, cross-task and replay do not authorize; rebuild validity from durable facts.
entries.minimum_verification: Source-backed snapshot definition and actual stale/replay/recovery tests.

entries.necessity: Preserve necessary perspectives, raw dissent and bounded disposition without imposing future fixed matrices.
entries.oracle: Profile declares finite propositions/necessity; authentic member discussion links original opinion; unresolved dissent stays visible; sends/task completion alone do not pass.
entries.minimum_verification: Real members exchange contradiction, response and disposition; cancelled/missing/unpublished output remains incomplete.

entries.necessity: Deliver independently installable Node package with explicit ownership and recoverable transitions.
entries.oracle: Exact package installs/repeats/upgrades/recovers/rolls back/uninstalls in isolated target, retaining unrelated data; doctor detects drift.
entries.minimum_verification: Installer lifecycle tests and package inventory/checksum checks.

entries.necessity: Demonstrate no source checkout or Python product prerequisite.
entries.oracle: OS-level source read denial and executable restrictions proven by controls; installed CLI and DSH/Team still work.
entries.minimum_verification: Sandbox-exec controls + exact installed tgz acceptance, recorded executable and platform versions.

entries.necessity: Switch only after replacement evidence and retire all first-party Python product paths.
entries.oracle: Final bytes revalidated; current docs/version/resources consistent; historical evidence retained; no public release or user profile replacement.
entries.minimum_verification: Boundary/link checks, final package manifest/checksums, final affected tests, reviewable commits.
